title: SSE receive: bytes.to_vec() copies every chunk unnecessarily
description: client.rs:325 — String::from_utf8(bytes.to_vec()) copies every incoming SSE chunk before UTF-8 validation. str::from_utf8(&bytes) validates in-place with no allocation; buf.push_str() on the resulting &str still works. In a long-running SSE stream this copy fires on every network chunk.
